population: XAUUSD frozen-M7C LONG trades entered at the first causal M1 turn on the user-supplied 2023-01-03 through 2026-06-19 GOLD history

evidence_status.reason: 2025 and 2026 were already research-exposed before M9O. M9O is robustness/canonicalization, not an untouched holdout.

canonical_semantics_for_reproduction.N1: At first-turn decision, use latest fully closed M5 bar. tick_volume_ratio20 = selected M5 tick volume / mean tick volume of selected plus prior 19 M5 bars. Require the full 20-bar ratio warmup and a full rolling feature window. N1 is true when the selected ratio is <= rolling quantile q1 of the latest W ratio observations.
canonical_semantics_for_reproduction.N2: At first-turn decision, use latest fully closed M15 bar. MACD line = EMA6(close)-EMA13(close), expressed in bps of selected close. Require a full rolling feature window. N2 is true when selected MACD line bps is >= rolling quantile q2 of the latest W M15 values.
canonical_semantics_for_reproduction.entry_execution: first causal M1 turn entry, historical spread-adjusted
canonical_semantics_for_reproduction.exit_execution: unchanged frozen M7C proxy exit, exact M1 open, historical spread-adjusted

m9n_reference_difference.note: M9N was assistant-side exploratory and had an early-history percentile warmup ambiguity. M9O adopts strict full-window warmup as canonical for deterministic reproduction.

parameter_neighborhood_stress.interpretation: N3 is not dependent on exactly W=200, q1=0.50 and q2=0.75. The adaptive concept survives a broad nearby parameter neighborhood.

canonical_N3_cost_sensitivity.note: These are stress deductions on top of historical spread treatment, not modeled commission/swap estimates.

quarter_stability.interpretation: N3 is materially more stable than prior static candidates but still has identifiable weak regimes; it is not a finished live rule.

secondary_tail_risk_observation.definition: Within canonical N3, compute closed H4 RCI9 empirical percentile using the latest 100 fully closed H4 bars after full warmup. Descriptive risk zone is percentile >0.25 and <=0.50.
secondary_tail_risk_observation.reason: The complement is robust, but the risk zone itself is not loss-making under every nearby definition and all periods are research-exposed.

resolved_only_health_gate.reason: Recent resolved-only PF gating was sensitive to lookback and threshold and often failed to reduce drawdown consistently. Simpler market-state N1/N2/N3 remains preferred.

research_decision: Freeze strict causal semantics for N1/N2/N3 for deterministic repository reproduction.
Keep N3 as the leading frequency-oriented GOLD LONG research candidate.
Keep N6 only as a secondary forward risk-shadow hypothesis; do not backfill-promote it.
Do not add SHORT to the main stack; 2023-2025 remains structurally weak.
Do not modify frozen M7C or reset M8C.
